description: This script sets up a performance test scenario for Git repositories involving multiple tags, commits, and packs. It creates a parent repository with a large number of disconnected tags and commits, clones it to create a child repository, and populates both with specific configurations to test the performance of tag-following and fetching operations.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Creates a linear history of commits on a specified branch with each commit pointing to a unique blob.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates a sequence of tags pointing to each commit in a specified revision range.
